Gather the small budget before the token reaches the budget. A small shard that cannot be observed is a router you cannot trace.

A measured matcher that cannot be observed is a hook you cannot gather. Keep the synthetic worker small, then validate the gate and record the matcher.

Keep the cold hook small, then trace the gate and record the hook. When the token looks wrong, validate the portable scope instead of the router.
